description_en: Queries nodes with configuration drift within a node group and the drift details
description_zh: 查询节点组内存在配置漂移的节点及漂移明细
name: ListNodeGroupDriftedNodes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en: Limits the check scope. If not specified, all nodes in the node group are checked. <warning>If the model is a super node, pass the TrayNode ID.</warning>
parameters.help_zh: 限定检查范围，不指定则检查节点组全部节点。<warning>若机型为超节点，传 TrayNode ID</warning>
parameters.name: node_ids

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的 NextToken 参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~500。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a single query
MaxResults.description_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数。

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned by this call. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值，为空表示没有下一页
NextToken.title_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值，为空表示没有下一页。

Nodes.description_en: The list of nodes that are inconsistent with the node group configuration (paginated)
Nodes.description_zh: 与节点组配置不一致的节点列表（分页）

PropertyDrifts.description_en: The list of inconsistent properties for this node
PropertyDrifts.description_zh: 该节点不一致的属性列表

ActualValue.description_en: The current value of the node property. Complex types are serialized as JSON strings
ActualValue.description_zh: 节点属性当前值，复杂类型序列化为 JSON 字符串
ActualValue.title_zh: 节点属性当前值，复杂类型序列化为 JSON 字符串

MinRequiredAction.description_en: The minimum action required to apply the TargetValue: Refresh, Reboot, or Reimage. For more information, refer to the MaxDisruptiveAction parameter description in the RefreshNodeGroupNodes operation
MinRequiredAction.description_zh: 使TargetValue生效所需的最低动作：Refresh / Reboot / Reimage，详情参见RefreshNodeGroupNodes接口入参MaxDisruptiveAction解释
MinRequiredAction.title_zh: 使TargetValue生效所需的最低动作：Refresh / Reboot / Reimage，详情参见RefreshNodeGroupNodes接口入参MaxDisruptiveAction解释。

PropertyPath.description_en: The property path in dot notation (such as a.b.c), compatible with both flat and nested properties
PropertyPath.description_zh: 属性路径（dot notation，如 a.b.c），兼容扁平与嵌套属性
PropertyPath.title_zh: 属性路径（dot notation，如 a.b.c），兼容扁平与嵌套属性

TargetValue.description_en: The target value of the node property. Complex types are serialized as JSON strings
TargetValue.description_zh: 节点属性目标值，复杂类型序列化为 JSON 字符串
TargetValue.title_zh: 节点属性目标值，复杂类型序列化为 JSON 字符串

PropertyDrifts.title_zh: 该节点不一致的属性列表

Nodes.title_zh: 与节点组配置不一致的节点列表（分页）
